function unbounded<T>(value: T extends unknown ? { id: number } : null) {
  return value.id;
}
function overlap<T extends string>(value: T extends "empty" ? null : { id: number }) {
  return value.id;
}
function partial<T extends 1 | 2>(value: T extends 1 ? { id: number } : null) {
  return value.id;
}
function unknownTarget<T extends { ready: true }, U>(value: T extends U ? { id: number } : null) {
  return value.id;
}
function noBound<T>(value: T extends never ? null : { id: number }) {
  return value.id;
}
function onlyNever<T extends never>(value: T extends never ? { id: number } : undefined) {
  return value.id;
}
